entries.29a4b7cfbe4d0123: While securing rental income from income properties held by the Group and treating fees for managing and operating real estate fractional-ownership products and office unit products after sale as pillars of revenue, this business provides property management for managed properties, real estate-based asset management consulting, real estate appraisal and due diligence, and others. Property management work covers tenant recruitment, move-in and move-out procedures, negotiation of lease terms, collection of overdue rent, building management and others. In Japan, A.D. Works Co., Ltd. and A.D. Partners Co., Ltd. handled this business, and in the United States ADW Management USA,Inc. did so. However, through an absorption-type company split effective January 13, 2026, A.D. Partners Co., Ltd. transferred its property management business for external owners to Architect Developer Co., Ltd., and the property management business for properties held by the Group and others was transferred to A.D. Works Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,598 million (90.9% year on year), and operating profit was ¥1,205 million.
entries.6b3532168339817e: This business takes as its revenue pillars the securing of rental income from income-producing properties held by the Group and fees for management and operation after the sale of fractional real estate products and office unit products, while also providing property management for entrusted properties, asset management consulting centered on real estate, real estate appraisal and due diligence.
entries.96284fbb3879fee3: This business purchases 1-building income-generating real estate through its own sales routes, adds value through scrutiny and improvement of building management conditions, changes of use, tenant replacement, large-scale repairs and development, and then sells it to investors centered on wealthy individuals, real estate owners, business corporations, institutional investors and others. It also sells real estate small-lot products that can be purchased from a minimum investment of ¥5 million, and office unit products in which each floor of a small office building in central Tokyo is registered as a separate unit, to investors nationwide through introductions by financial institutions, accounting firms and others. In Japan, A.D.Works Co., Ltd. carries out this business, and in the United States, ADW-No.1 LLC, ADW Hawaii LLC, Avenue Works Normandie LLC and Avenue Works Ardmore LLC do so (ADW-No.1 LLC completed the sale of its held properties and was dissolved, and liquidation procedures were continuing as of December 31, 2025). In the fiscal year ended December 2025, revenue was ¥62,436 million (140.9% of the previous fiscal year) and operating profit was ¥6,361 million.
entries.99babcb8a7c9638e: A real estate company that buys 1-building income-producing properties, adds value and sells them to investors and others, and also earns management fees and rent.
